title: Handling of network rejection not due to APN based congestion control

entities.name: EPS session management reject message
entities.description: Message sent by network to reject EPS session management procedure, may contain back-off timer value and re-attempt indicator.

entities.name: Back-off timer
entities.description: Timer value included in EPS session management reject message to regulate UE retry interval for same procedure.

entities.name: Re-attempt indicator
entities.description: Indicator specifying whether UE can re-attempt session management procedure for same APN in different modes after inter-system change.

entities.name: ESM cause #26 insufficient resources
entities.description: Specific ESM cause value that affects network's inclusion of re-attempt indicator in reject message.

entities.name: PLMN and APN combination
entities.description: Combination of PLMN and APN that back-off timer is associated with, determining scope of timer applicability.

entities.name: Emergency PDN connection
entities.description: Special PDN connection type that is not affected by back-off timer for PLMN with no APN combination.

entities.name: Equivalent PLMN list
entities.description: List of PLMNs considered equivalent for back-off timer applicability when indicated in re-attempt indicator.

entities.name: UE configured to use AC11-15
entities.description: UE configuration that allows initiation of procedures even when back-off timer is running for PLMN and APN combination.

relations.description: EPS session management reject message may contain back-off timer value.
EPS session management reject message may contain re-attempt indicator.
For ESM cause values other than #26, network may include re-attempt indicator.
Back-off timer is associated with specific PLMN and APN combination.
Back-off timer for PLMN with no APN is never started for emergency PDN connections.
Re-attempt indicator may specify back-off applies to all PLMNs in equivalent PLMN list.
UEs configured with AC11-15 can initiate procedures even when back-off timer is running.
